question: Haryana government announced ______ to provide support to women entrepreneurs, on International Women’s Day 2022.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Matrushakti Udaymita Scheme.**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Matrushakti Udaymita Scheme** was announced to **facilitate women entrepreneurs in Haryana** and to provide them with a supportive ecosystem for business.
 
• The primary aim of this scheme is to create better **opportunities for women in the business sector** and to uplift their socioeconomic status.
 
• This initiative by the Haryana government reflects their **efforts toward gender equality and women's empowerment.**
 
• The announcement was notably made on** International Women's Day 2022, **which emphasizes the significance of the initiative in promoting gender parity.
 
• The Matrushakti Udaymita Scheme is a part of several initiatives being undertaken by various governments in India to encourage female entrepreneurship and to **reduce gender disparity** in the business environment.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **UJJWALA Scheme:**

 
 
• **The Pradhan Mantri Ujjwala Yojana (PMUY)**, also known as the **UJJWALA Scheme**, is a social welfare program initiated by the Indian Government.
 
• It was launched with the primary objective of providing** clean cooking fuel to poor households in rural and semi-urban areas.**
 
• The scheme supports **providing LPG connections** to families below the poverty line.
 
 
 
• **Mahila E-Haat Scheme:**
 
 
• Mahila E-haat was launched by the** Ministry of Women and Child Development, Government of India,** to encourage women entrepreneurs and self-help groups (SHGs).
 
• This direct online marketing platform **provides a space for women to showcase their products** across the globe without any charge.
 
• The objective is to strengthen the financial inclusion of women entrepreneurs in the economy by providing a platform where they can market their products worldwide.
 
 
 
• **SWADHAR Scheme:**
 
 
• The SWADHAR Scheme is an effort by the **Ministry of Women and Child Development in India** to uplift and provide a **better life to women in moral danger due to circumstances.**
 
• The scheme provides a supportive institutional framework where women **can be protected and rehabilitated.**
 
• Services provided under this scheme include **food, shelter, counselling, vocational training, and legal aid **to manage their personal and social issues.
